ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
085
Behind the image
49 / Navy Polo
REFERENCE 5819.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 037
Art direction: Collegiate layering, navy and white with a warm suede accent, windswept hair, clean
white backdrop.
Photorealistic vertical fashion editorial of an original adult woman with light brown hair in a long
loose side braid with wispy flyaway strands, thin rectangular metal glasses, natural makeup and
soft pink lips, looking at the camera with a calm, cool expression. She wears a navy textured knit
polo sweater with white stripes on the collar and hem, layered over a blue gingham shirt, a navy
pleated mini skirt with a drawstring waist, and holds a soft brown suede slouch bag with a small
golden tulip charm. Clean white studio background, bright even light, collegiate Y2K styling, no
text or logos.
50 / Olive Hosiery
REFERENCE 5818.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 038
Art direction: Tonal olive, ivory and chocolate, 1960s mod simplicity, moody studio light.
Photorealistic vertical full-length studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman with sleek
straight blonde hair parted in the center, a calm, composed gaze and nude-rose lips, standing with
her legs crossed and one hand holding her opposite arm. She wears oversized white flower
statement earrings, a fitted ivory ribbed turtleneck, a chocolate-brown wool mini skirt, sage-green
sheer tights and black pointed pumps. Deep olive-green seamless backdrop, soft directional studio
light, tonal olive, ivory and chocolate palette, 1960s mod-inspired minimalism, no text or logos.
